runs.text: Step-by-step instructions: sign in, create a workspace, invite colleagues and install the aezcheck extension to get started.
This guide takes you through your first steps on aezcheck.com — from signing in to operating a complete workspace with all your assets and teammates.

Each account can join multiple workspaces with different roles.

A workspace is a separate working environment containing all assets (VIA, Business Manager, ad accounts), payment cards, personnel and activity logs. An agency typically creates 1 workspace per customer to keep permissions and reconciliation clearly separated.
